aiRules.title: AI-Detected SQL Injection Attack
aiRules.ruleDescription: A SQL Injection attack consists of insertion or "injection" of a SQL query via the input data from the client to the application.

aiRules.title: AI-Detected XSS Attack
aiRules.ruleDescription: Cross-Site Scripting attacks are a type of injection problem, in which malicious scripts are injected into otherwise benign web sites.
